test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

Sana said, “I am going to pick up the children now.”

options.text: Sana said that she was going to pick up the children then.
Sana said that she was going to pick up the children now.
Sana said that I am going to pick up the children then.
Sana said that I am going to pick up the children now.

solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. 'Sana said that she was going to pick up the children then.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the given directions, we have to change it into Indirect Speech.
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be added and comma and inverted commas will be removed.
 
• In the Indirect speech 'said' will not be changed because reporting verb has no object.
 
• The indirect speech will begin like 'Sana said.'
 
• Now we have to change the reported speech.
 
• Here 'I' will be changed into 'she.'
 
• Here, 'am going' is in present continuous tense and will be changed into past continuous tense i.e., 'was going.'
 
• Also, 'now' will be changed into 'then.'
 
• Finally, the indirect speech is 'Sana said that she was going to pick up the children then.'
 
• ​So, the correct answer is option 1.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *Sana said that she was going to pick up the children then.*
